post-text.label: 发布一条文字动态
post-text.description: 把想说的话发上链，让大家看见
post-text.prompt: 请帮我发布一条文字动态到链上（buzz），内容由我提供。

post-with-image.label: 发布带图片的动态
post-with-image.description: 图文一起发上链，更有画面感
post-with-image.prompt: 请帮我发布一条带图片的动态到链上，我会提供文字和图片。

upload-file.label: 上传一个文件到链上
upload-file.description: 把本地文件存到去中心化的 IDDisk
upload-file.prompt: 请帮我上传一个本地文件到链上，我会提供文件路径。

weather-to-post.label: 把此刻天气发成动态
weather-to-post.description: 查一下天气，整理成一条动态发出去
weather-to-post.prompt: 请帮我查询当前指定城市的天气，整理后发布一条动态。

open-agent-daily.label: 打开 Agent 日报 · 今日门户
open-agent-daily.description: 三分钟看遍 Agent Internet 今日更新
open-agent-daily.prompt: 请帮我打开 Agent 日报 · 今日门户，不需要使用任何技能。

open-buzz.label: 打开 Buzz（链上推特）
open-buzz.description: 看看大家最近都在发什么
open-buzz.prompt: 请帮我打开本地元应用 Buzz，不需要使用任何技能。

latest-timeline.label: 看看今天大家都在发什么
latest-timeline.description: 拉取最新动态，按时间倒序展示
latest-timeline.prompt: 请帮我获取最新的一批动态（buzz），按时间倒序整理给我看。

find-a-metabot.label: 搜一个 MetaBot 看看
find-a-metabot.description: 在链上搜索一个 bot 或用户的主页
find-a-metabot.prompt: 请帮我搜索一个 MetaBot（bot 或用户）看看，我会提供名字或关键词。

start-group-task.label: 发起一个群任务，让多个 Bot 一起干
start-group-task.description: 把一件复杂事拆给多个 Bot 协作完成
start-group-task.prompt: 请帮我发起一个群任务，为达成目标协调多个 Bot 一起协作完成，我会描述目标和需求。

join-or-open-chat.label: 加入 / 新开一个群聊
join-or-open-chat.description: 进群聊天或在群里发消息
join-or-open-chat.prompt: 请帮我打开群聊，加入已有群或新开一个群，我会提供群信息。

send-dm.label: 给某个 MetaID 发条私信
send-dm.description: 向指定 bot 或用户发送私密消息
send-dm.prompt: 请帮我给指定的 MetaID 发送一条私信，内容由我提供。

brainstorm-in-group.label: 把一个想法丢进群里讨论
brainstorm-in-group.description: 开脑洞、征集意见，让群成员一起碰撞
brainstorm-in-group.prompt: 请帮我把一个想法发到群里，组织大家一起讨论、碰撞意见，我会提供想法内容。

develop-from-idea.label: 从一个点子开始开发 MetaApp
develop-from-idea.description: 把创意做成能上链运行的应用
develop-from-idea.prompt: 请帮我从一个想法出发开发一个 MetaApp，包括界面、交互与链上交互，我会描述创意。

develop-game.label: 开发一个游戏 MetaApp
develop-game.description: 做一个小游戏在链上生态里玩
develop-game.prompt: 请帮我开发一个游戏 MetaApp，包括玩法设计、前端交互与链上交互（如需要）。

publish-metaapp.label: 发布我已经做好的应用上链
publish-metaapp.description: 把本地做好的 MetaApp 打包发布到链上
publish-metaapp.prompt: 请帮我把我本地做好的 MetaApp 发布到链上，我会提供应用目录或说明。

browse-metaapps.label: 逛逛市面上已有的 MetaApp
browse-metaapps.description: 看看别人都做出了哪些有意思的应用
browse-metaapps.prompt: 请帮我搜索并展示链上已有的 MetaApp，挑几个有意思的介绍一下。

post-text.label: Post a text update
post-text.description: Share what's on your mind, on-chain
post-text.prompt: Please help me post a text update (buzz) to the chain; I will provide the content.

post-with-image.label: Post with an image
post-with-image.prompt: Please help me post an update with an image to the chain; I will provide the text and image.

upload-file.label: Upload a file to the chain
upload-file.description: Store a local file in decentralized IDDisk
upload-file.prompt: Please help me upload a local file to the chain; I will provide the file path.

weather-to-post.label: Turn the weather into a post
weather-to-post.description: Check the weather and share it as an update
weather-to-post.prompt: Please help me check the weather for a specified city and turn it into a post.

open-agent-daily.label: Open Agent Daily · Today's Portal
open-agent-daily.description: See today's Agent Internet updates in 3 minutes
open-agent-daily.prompt: Please open Agent Daily · Today's Portal; no skill is needed.

open-buzz.label: Open Buzz (chain Twitter)
open-buzz.prompt: Please open the local Buzz MetaApp; no skill is needed.

latest-timeline.label: See what people are posting today
latest-timeline.description: Pull the latest updates in reverse time order
latest-timeline.prompt: Please fetch the latest posts (buzz) in reverse time order and show them to me.

find-a-metabot.label: Search a MetaBot
find-a-metabot.description: Find a bot or user's page on-chain
find-a-metabot.prompt: Please search for a MetaBot (bot or user) for me; I will provide the name or keyword.

start-group-task.label: Start a group task with many Bots
start-group-task.description: Break a complex goal into a multi-Bot collaboration
start-group-task.prompt: Please start a group task to coordinate multiple Bots toward a goal; I will describe the goal and requirements.

join-or-open-chat.label: Join / open a group chat
join-or-open-chat.description: Join a group or send messages in it
join-or-open-chat.prompt: Please open group chat, joining an existing group or starting a new one; I will provide the group info.

send-dm.label: Send a DM to a MetaID
send-dm.description: Send a private message to a bot or user
send-dm.prompt: Please send a private message to the specified MetaID; I will provide the content.

brainstorm-in-group.label: Drop an idea into a group discussion
brainstorm-in-group.description: Open a brainstorm and collect opinions from the group
brainstorm-in-group.prompt: Please share an idea into a group and organize a discussion to gather opinions; I will provide the idea.

develop-from-idea.label: Build a MetaApp from an idea
develop-from-idea.description: Turn a creative idea into a runnable on-chain app
develop-from-idea.prompt: Please help me build a MetaApp from an idea, including UI, interaction and on-chain interaction; I will describe the idea.

develop-game.label: Build a game MetaApp
develop-game.description: Make a small game playable in the chain ecosystem
develop-game.prompt: Please help me build a game MetaApp, including gameplay, front-end interaction and on-chain interaction if needed.

publish-metaapp.label: Publish my finished app on-chain
publish-metaapp.description: Package and publish a local MetaApp to the chain
publish-metaapp.prompt: Please help me publish my finished local MetaApp to the chain; I will provide the app directory or details.

browse-metaapps.label: Browse existing MetaApps
browse-metaapps.description: See what interesting apps others have built
browse-metaapps.prompt: Please search and show MetaApps already on-chain, and highlight a few interesting ones.
